name: yanzhi_met_fit
title: 胭脂红卡：拟合到 Met 照片的灯
what: museum_flat refitted to Met 1971.180.248 (materials/yanzhi/lightfit; docs/materials/yanzhi.md, round 2). Fitted on a probe grid (60 cm softboxes at 1 m), see the doc for residuals.

spectrum.why: v0: every lamp of a rig has the same spectrum, the key light rgbscene projects with, so one bounce is exact (docs/optics.md); 5500 K blackbody: a stand-in for daylight-balanced studio flash or LED, our choice

lamps.name: mainL
lamps.why: [F] the left reflection in the inside's far wall, photo u -0.38 v 0.52 (probe az 60 el 45: -0.37, 0.60; el 60: 0.30)

lamps.name: mainR
lamps.why: [F] the right reflection, photo u +0.45 v 0.54 (probe az 75 el 45: +0.46, 0.58); the photo's pair is not symmetric

lamps.name: rearL
lamps.why: [F] rgfit.py: a rear pair at 0.25 x the main's illuminance brightens the outer wall's sides and the sweep

lamps.name: top
lamps.why: [F] lightfit/rgfit.py: 0.5 x museum_flat's top (500 lux) relative to the main pair's 1000

backdrop.why: [F/A] the photo's backdrop is 0.66-0.73 of the inside's white and the wall's neutral sheen (G channel) needs a bright surround: rgfit.py's best reflectance 0.72-0.84; white_90 is the nearest material in optics/backdrops.json (rho 0.84 scores 0.685 against 0.650)
